component-metadata.description:
Metanode for processing Skyline outputs from histone analysis with TMA derivatization. Several inputs are necessary, see input port descriptions.
=================
Used programs and tools and their respective licenses at the time of the metanode creation. Version numbers and the licenses might differ based on your local installation. Please inspect your local installation and contact us if you can not locate your local version and or license terms.
KNIME nodes (The KNIME nodes consists of the following GNU GPL 3.0 License. Licence terms are available here: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl.html) Python 3 (The Python consists of the following Python 3 License. Licence terms are available here: https://docs.python.org/3/license.html) R 4.2.0 (The R consists of the following GPL-3 License. License terms are available here: https://www.r-project.org/Licenses/GPL-3)
The metanode was created in KNIME 5.9.0 running inside the docker image (https://hub.docker.com/r/cfprot/knime/), tag 5.9.0a.

in-ports.port: Table exported from Skyline containing data to be processed
Imported FASTA file containing full sequences and other information about histone proteins
Information about possible protein modifications and their expected mass

out-ports.port: Table with summed areas for individual modifications
